_note: PixelLab map-object provenance for art_obstacles (T133 / ChocoThunder2-cgo, PRD Story 15). create_map_object, view='low top-down', outline='single color outline', shading='detailed shading', detail='high detail', transparent bg, bold/saturated per-room palette. Objects auto-delete after 8h; the committed PNGs in pixellab/obstacles/<room>/ are the durable artifact. Engine renders each fit to config.OBSTACLE_RENDER_MAX preserving aspect (decoupled from the OBSTACLE_SIZE hitbox).
